changelog:
- Initial release of the high-value-patent-package skill.
- Generates a high-value patent screening report (HTML, Word optional) from PatSnap/智慧芽 patent queries, based on weighted metrics: simple family citations (30%), simple family count (30%), core inventors (20%), and legal event history (20%).
- Automatically selects the top 10–15% of patents by score and includes required fields, evidence, and selection reasons.
- Ensures all patent data comes directly from PatSnap/智慧芽 APIs; marks unavailable data as `未获取` and tracks API failures.
- Provides clickable publication numbers linking to source patent pages.
- Always delivers an HTML report and tracking file; generates a DOCX report only on explicit user request.
summary: Screen high-value patent packages and generate an HTML report (Word optional).
